summary: The CLI iterations control a direct timed loop; CSR generation closes the final row at n=floor(dim²/sparsity). Width is selected from mean nnz per row as 2/4/8/16/32 through average<=512, otherwise width=256 invokes the long-row path. Short-row grid is ceil(dim*width/256), and each row is assigned a unique subgroup with full CSR traversal in width strides, reduction and lane-zero store. Long rows launch dim blocks; each 256-thread block accumulates that row’s full CSR interval in blockDim strides, reduces and stores. The synchronized warmup is before start-event recording. Compiled main repeats the launch helper until the requested iteration counter is reached, then records/synchronizes the stop event; selected width reaches the launchSpmv switch and each selected width-specific CUDA wrapper or long-row stub through cudaLaunchKernel. Inspected all six native sm86 kernels through row/nonzero arithmetic backedges, reductions/stores and exits. No omission identified.
